verdict.rationale: Vanta's API docs mention that the platform can automate evidence collection across system categories including Mobile Device Managers (MDM), implying workstation compliance monitoring, but the evidence pack never details per-employee tracking of specific checks like disk encryption, screen lock, or password manager status via an agent. Missing for 10: explicit description of the Vanta agent/MDM integration, named checks (disk encryption, screen lock, password manager), and per-employee dashboard/reporting evidence.
